## Details

<a id="work_bitmap"></a>
### [`work_bitmap`](../../../../src/data/work_bitmap.asm#L6) `$A50E-$A52D`

*variable*

Work bitmap of the fight area: 8 character rows of 320 bytes (bitmap rows 14-21). The fighters are drawn here. The arena change at $8d07 also uses $a50e-$b50d as 16 rows of 256 bytes and swaps it with $d000-$dfff.

- **Referred to by:** [`draw_fighter`](../fighter/draw.md#draw_fighter)

<a id="work_strip0"></a>
### [`work_strip0`](../../../../src/data/work_bitmap.asm#L9) `$A52E-$A66D`

*variable*

Columns 4-35 of each work bitmap row start at $a52e+320k (256 bytes). $8b41 copies them to the screen bitmap.

- **Read by:** [`show_work_bitmap`](../screen/fight_area.md#show_work_bitmap)
- **Written by:** [`restore_work_bitmap`](../screen/fight_area.md#restore_work_bitmap)

*variable*
